instruction:
Please act as a professional Verilog designer. Your task is to create a Verilog module that implements a Reed-Solomon encoder and decoder. 
Reed-Solomon codes are a type of error-correcting code that can detect and correct errors in data transmission. 
The encoder takes a block of data and adds redundancy to it in order to create a codeword that can be transmitted. 
The decoder takes the received codeword and corrects any errors that may have occurred during transmission.

Your module should have the following inputs and outputs:

Inputs: a set of k input symbols (in1, in2, ..., ink)
Outputs: a set of n output symbols (out1, out2, ..., outn)
The module should also have the following parameters:

k: the number of input symbols
n: the number of output symbols
t: the number of errors that can be corrected
Your module should implement the following functionality:

The encoder should take the k input symbols and add redundancy to create the n output symbols.
The decoder should take the received n symbols and correct up to t errors.
To implement the Reed-Solomon encoder and decoder, you should use Verilog code to define the polynomial arithmetic operations that are used in the encoding and decoding algorithms. 
You should then use these operations to create the encoder and decoder modules.
Finally, you should use the encoder to create a codeword from the input symbols, and use the decoder to correct any errors that occur during transmission.
